selection_data: validation only; report PlantDoc and PlantVillage separately
acceptance_definition: Raw model max probability >=0.75 and predicted != Unsupported, before API field-healthy review. Coverage denominator is all PlantDoc validation records, including Unsupported.
deployment: Candidate remains optional unless all validation criteria pass. Test is measured once after configuration and calibration are fixed, not used to tune.
limitations: No score threshold guarantees OOD detection. Manual crop is not leaf segmentation. Physical Android/iPhone and new pest classes require separate testing/data.
